comments.value: I can only support something in that direction. The recent verification Mail is pretty "meh" for content creators and a new, easy to use and SAFE system would help a lot.

it always was a bad idea to share log in data but its to only way. So it woud be realy helpfull to have such a feature (In case you want to give a friend a private model that shoudnt be public (payed/nsfw avatars))

I think generating a key and sending it over is unnecessary, there already exist a mailbox on the website so it would be easier to be able to "mail" avatars to friends and then they'll have to accept them on the website.
@{58c6b8f8227a56787575ebc0|full_name}: honestly at this point anything that will make it to where I don’t have to log in to other peoples accounts will be nice

This would make so much stuff like sharing a avatar with just friend so much more easy. Sometimes you wanna share a avatar with friends, and as soon you make it public people can grab it over the api. So and if people abuse the effects on it you can get in trouble. Would be an nice idea to share your models just with people you trust.

I cannot agree more. As many have already said, including OP, we need some kind of safe, and simple system, like a one-time key system, and it would make things like sharing private avatars so much easier. Please do make this a feature.

I'm probably asking a dumb question here, but wouldn't simply delivering a .unitypackage file be the safer alternative, as well as giving the client the rights to the avatar so they could edit it later if they wish? Clients wouldn't need to give out their login information and they could control who has access to their avatar.
For the case like Major stated, having a way to share a private avatar with a select few that you authorize would be great.

@{5ea21fa66c958c1951ad63e6|full_name}: Some avatar authors don't like selling unity packages as it then gets leaked and shoved around to friends (and then those friends shove it around to more friends), so they prefer a direct upload to the account instead to prevent any leaking.

@{5bad5c3ff0fbe557387ab6f2|full_name}: I mean, that's a fair point. I guess it just feels weird to me to charge people for an avatar they don't even own. I feel like if someone has paid actual money for an avatar, they should at least have some usage rights beyond just having it on their account. But that's an entirely different discussion from the original feature request, so I digress.
@{5ea21fa66c958c1951ad63e6|full_name}: there are people who dont know how to use unity or have the time to learn it

You are basically asking for what other games like ChilloutVR already have, i dont know why games like VRChat just dont wanna follow up on this. They have a key based system. They have avatar sharing. They even have avatar transfers.

@{5ea21fa66c958c1951ad63e6|full_name}: my simple rule, no one, and i mean, NO ONE, gets my account credentials, because if the person who logs in on my account later gets banned, my account is associated with them and can (and (probably would) be banned as well, no unity package no sell, simple as that (plus its right there in the TOS, do NOT share account info)

details:
Hello,
I have been doing commissions and creating models for many people on  VRC for a while now, others that do the same will  know of the problem with VRChats newest verification system.
You have to sign into other peoples account. Its allways been like that. But after that the buyer has to verify a email that is send to the email adress that is  linked to the VRC account of the buyer.
This makes it more of a pain to upload models for content creators because some of the buyers don't get that important verification email.
So I came up with a idea.
I think there should be a new system implemented for anyone who want's to share a model with someone  else.
The way I thought of going about it, and I bet many other had the same  idea, is by creating a key based system where a creator can generate a key, by generating a key, the creator is uploading the avatar into the VRChat cloud.
Now the creator, sends the key  to the person that is wanting the model and all they have to do is put the code in there VRC Account on VRChats website and the model will be put on there account.
Of  course it's a one time use.
 I've seen it done on other Social VR Platforms and I would love to see it on VRChat. It will make sharing models a lot easier and safer.
Thank you for your attention.
title: making sharing models simpel and safe
